headline: Mukta Arts releases financial results for Q2 FY27
hook: Mukta Arts reports September quarter results
summary: Mukta Arts Limited has filed its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with the National Stock Exchange. The filing provides the official performance data for the company during this period. Retail investors can access the detailed balance sheet and profit-loss statement through the exchange portal to assess the company's current financial health.
why_it_matters: Review the latest earnings to gauge company profitability and growth.

headline: Mukta Arts notifies stock exchange about postal ballot
hook: Postal ballot notice issued to shareholders
summary: Mukta Arts Limited has officially informed the stock exchanges regarding the issuance of a notice for a postal ballot. The filing is a procedural corporate requirement for obtaining shareholder approval on specific resolutions. Such filings are standard regulatory disclosures made by listed companies. Indian retail investors holding shares in the company should check the postal ballot details for upcoming corporate decisions.
why_it_matters: Review postal ballot details for upcoming corporate resolutions.
